trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is awarded automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work the roadmap stages in order — the story first, then the stranger strands, collectibles and activities, then the free-roam feats — and watch the earned count in this tracker climb toward 54. When the last bronze, silver or gold pops, this one follows on the same sync. Its official description, 'Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend.', is the whole requirement: be a legend by finishing everything else.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission of the story, and this trophy pops when you complete it. Treat it as the starting gun for the whole roadmap — every later stage assumes the story has begun here.
